name: moreai-metaagent
description: MoreAI MetaAgent: an Agentic Commerce assistant built on Meta's models.

scripts.local:setup: cd apps/api && npx wrangler d1 execute moreai-metaagent --local --file schema.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute moreai-metaagent --local --file seed/seed.sql
scripts.local:start: npm run build:live --workspace @metaagent/web && cd apps/api && npx wrangler dev
